questions.q: What does this capstone argue about the seven chapters that came before it?
options: They function as one operating SOC system, not seven disconnected topics
Each chapter replaces the need for the one before it
Only Chapter 4's correlation rules actually matter for real SOC work
They should each be evaluated as fully independent, unrelated skills
questions.explain: The capstone's point, proven directly by Lesson 31's case, is that detection, process, and automation only work together as one system.

questions.q: Which pair of chapters is directly responsible for turning a raw login record into something worth an analyst's attention?
options: Chapters 2-3 (collection and normalization) feeding Chapter 4 (correlation logic)
Chapter 6 (dashboards) and Chapter 7 (SOAR) alone
Chapter 5 (triage) without needing any log source at all
Chapter 1 (SOC roles) acting entirely on its own
questions.explain: Collection and normalization get the data in, and correlation logic is what turns normalized events into an actual alert.

questions.q: According to this lesson, why does a confirmed incident with no SOAR playbook behind it take longer to resolve?
options: A missing playbook prevents the SIEM from logging the incident at all
Incidents without a SOAR playbook can never actually be resolved
SOAR playbooks are required by law for every confirmed incident
The repeatable containment steps have to be performed manually each time instead of executed automatically
questions.explain: Lesson 31 showed roughly 40 minutes of manual steps compressed to under 3 minutes once a playbook automated the repeatable actions.

questions.q: What does Chapter 6's dashboard and MTTD/MTTR metrics capture about a case like Lesson 31's?
options: They measure only how many alerts a SIEM platform can generate per day
They replace the need for a Tier 2 investigation entirely
They are purely internal numbers that never leave the SOC team
They turn a resolved incident into a measurable, reportable result that reaches leadership
questions.explain: Every stage of a case is timestamped, feeding MTTD, MTTR, and the kind of summary that ends up in a leadership report.

questions.q: What course comes next in this career path after this one?
options: Advanced Python for Security Automation
Microsoft Sentinel, Defender XDR & KQL
Digital Forensics and Incident Response
Cloud Security Architecture
questions.explain: This course closes with a direct hand-off into the vendor-specific Microsoft Sentinel, Defender XDR & KQL course next in the path.
